model: CAS-2700-16 Irisys People Counter Gateway (example building)
equipment_type: People counter sensor via BACnet gateway
applies_to: Irisys thermal people counter sensors on the network, read by a Chipkin CAS-2700-16 gateway.
summary: The Chipkin CAS-2700-16 reads Irisys thermal people counters over the network and serves counts on BACnet IP. You enter buildings, floors and sensors on the gateway web page; it then creates an occupancy Analog Input per building and per floor and seven Analog Inputs per sensor (counts in/out, occupancy, normalized occupancy, raw device counts, reset value). The list shown is the manual example: one building, one floor, one sensor.
notes: From the BACnet configuration example (one building, one floor, one sensor). Object names are built from the names you enter, as "Building:Floor:Sensor - Value".
Each added building, floor or sensor adds objects; instances follow the order they were created.
The manual gives no units; values are people counts.
There is no access column; all objects are Analog Inputs and read-only.

source.title: Chipkin Irisys People Counter User Manual (CAS-2700-16)

integration.summary: Add each building, floor and sensor on the People Counter Client Config page, reboot the gateway, then read the occupancy objects over BACnet IP.

minimum_points.name: West Building:Ground floor:Main Entrance - Count In
West Building:Ground floor:Main Entrance - Count Out

integration.heartbeat: If the gateway cannot read a sensor, the object Out_Of_Service is set true and Present_Value keeps the last good value.
setup: Gateway device instance 389001 in the example (device name PeopleCounter); give each gateway a unique instance.
Reboot the gateway after changing the configuration.
Discovery across subnets needs a BBMD supplied by the BAS installer.
gotchas: Object names and instances depend on the buildings, floors and sensors you configure; map by name.
Count In / Count Out restart at the reset hour.
